email.subject: Quick question about Contoso's SEO

Hi,

I ran a quick audit of contoso.com and found 34 broken backlinks hurting your ranking.

We do guest posts and lead generation for B2B SaaS companies. Would you be open to a 15-minute call this week to see how we could increase your traffic?
